channel.description: Last 10 notes on The Wild Beyond the Witchlight

item.title: House Rules
item.description: The rules we play by D&D 5e, 2014 rules.

item.title: The Carnival Flyer
item.description: These turned up overnight, pinned to every door, fence post and tavern board for miles around. Nobody saw who put them there.

item.title: What People Say
item.description: When the flyers go up, everyone suddenly has a story about the Witchlight Carnival. Some of these are true. Some are half true.

item.title: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight
item.description: A fairy tale with teeth. Once every eight years, a carnival comes to town. Nobody sees it arrive.
